# IRoundsVaultRegistry
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultRegistry.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IRoundsVaultRegistryErrors](./i-rounds-vault-registry-errors.md), [IRoundsVaultRegistryEvents](./i-rounds-vault-registry-events.md)

**Title:**
IRoundsVaultRegistry

Discovery registry for `RoundsVaultInput` / `RoundsVaultOutput` pairs that wrap institutional
FleetCommanders. The companion subgraph spawns per-vault data sources off of this contract's
events, so the event shape is part of the public contract.

Pairs are keyed by `keccak256(targetVault)` because every FleetCommander has at most one
active rounds-vault pair at any time. Deactivation is soft to preserve history for indexers.

Mutator functions are `onlyOwner` (OpenZeppelin `Ownable`). The registry is shared across
institutions (each institution operates its own `ProtocolAccessManagerV2`), so the owner is
expected to be the protocol multisig — distinct from any per-fleet Governor role.


## Functions
### getPairId

Derive the storage key for a pair from its target vault address.


```solidity
function getPairId(address targetVault) external pure returns (bytes32);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetVault`|`address`|The FleetCommander vault address to derive a pair id for.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes32`|The `keccak256(targetVault)` pair id used to key the registry.|


### exists

Returns true if a pair with this id has ever been registered (may be inactive).


```solidity
function exists(bytes32 pairId) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id to check.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if a record exists for `pairId` (active or deactivated), false otherwise.|


### getPair

Returns the stored pair, reverting if it does not exist.


```solidity
function getPair(bytes32 pairId) external view returns (RoundsVaultPair memory pair);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id to look up.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pair`|`RoundsVaultPair`|The stored `RoundsVaultPair` record for `pairId`.|


### getPairByTarget

Returns the pair associated with a given target vault, reverting if not registered.


```solidity
function getPairByTarget(address targetVault) external view returns (RoundsVaultPair memory pair);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|

|`targetVault`|`address`|The FleetCommander vault address whose pair is being looked up.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pair`|`RoundsVaultPair`|The stored `RoundsVaultPair` record for the derived pair id.|

### pairIdAt

Returns the pairId at a given index in the enumerable list.


```solidity

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes32`|The pair id at position `index`.|


### registerPair

Register a new rounds-vault pair for `targetVault`.

Reverts if a pair already exists for this target, if `targetVault` is zero, if both
input and output are zero, or if either provided vault's `vault()` view does not match
`targetVault` or its `VAULT_TYPE()` does not match its slot. Owner-gated.


```solidity
function registerPair(bytes32 institutionId, address targetVault, address inputVault, address outputVault) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`institutionId`|`bytes32`|Caller-defined tag used to group pairs by institution off-chain.|
|`targetVault`|`address`|The FleetCommander both rounds-vaults wrap. Must be non-zero.|
|`inputVault`|`address`|The Input-flavor rounds-vault address, or `address(0)` if only the Output side is being registered.|
|`outputVault`|`address`|The Output-flavor rounds-vault address, or `address(0)` if only the Input side is being registered. At least one of `inputVault` / `outputVault` must be non-zero.|


### setInputVault

Set or replace the input-flavor vault for an existing pair.

Reverts with:
- `PairNotFound(pairId)` if no pair is registered for `pairId`.
- `UseClearInsteadOfZero(pairId)` if `inputVault == address(0)` (use `clearInputVault` instead).
- `TargetMismatch` if `inputVault.vault() != pair.targetVault`.
- `VaultFlavorMismatch` if `inputVault.VAULT_TYPE() != Input`.
Emits `RoundsVaultPairUpdated` with the post-change values. Owner-gated.


```solidity
function setInputVault(bytes32 pairId, address inputVault) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id whose input slot is being set.|
|`inputVault`|`address`|The new Input-flavor rounds-vault address (must be non-zero).|


### setOutputVault

Set or replace the output-flavor vault for an existing pair.

Same validation rules as `setInputVault` but requires `VAULT_TYPE == Output`.
Reverts with `PairNotFound(pairId)` if no pair is registered for `pairId`.
Owner-gated.


```solidity
function setOutputVault(bytes32 pairId, address outputVault) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id whose output slot is being set.|
|`outputVault`|`address`|The new Output-flavor rounds-vault address (must be non-zero).|


### clearInputVault

Drop the input vault from a pair.

Reverts with `PairNotFound(pairId)` if no pair is registered for `pairId`, or with
`UpdateWouldEmptyPair(pairId)` if the output side is also empty.
Emits `RoundsVaultPairUpdated`. Owner-gated.


```solidity
function clearInputVault(bytes32 pairId) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id whose input slot should be cleared.|


### clearOutputVault

Drop the output vault from a pair.

Reverts with `PairNotFound(pairId)` if no pair is registered for `pairId`, or with
`UpdateWouldEmptyPair(pairId)` if the input side is also empty.
Emits `RoundsVaultPairUpdated`. Owner-gated.


```solidity
function clearOutputVault(bytes32 pairId) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id whose output slot should be cleared.|


### deactivatePair

Mark a pair inactive without removing it. Owner-gated.

Reverts with `PairNotFound(pairId)` if no pair is registered for `pairId`, or with
`PairStateUnchanged(pairId)` if the pair is already inactive.
Emits `RoundsVaultPairDeactivated`.


```solidity
function deactivatePair(bytes32 pairId) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id to deactivate.|


### reactivatePair

Re-enable a previously-deactivated pair. Owner-gated.

Reverts with `PairNotFound(pairId)` if no pair is registered for `pairId`, or with
`PairStateUnchanged(pairId)` if the pair is already active.
Emits `RoundsVaultPairReactivated`.


```solidity
function reactivatePair(bytes32 pairId) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`pairId`|`bytes32`|The pair id to reactivate.|


## Structs
### RoundsVaultPair
On-chain record of a rounds-vault pair.

`inputVault` or `outputVault` may be zero if only one flavor is deployed for this fleet.


```solidity
struct RoundsVaultPair {
    address inputVault;
    address outputVault;
    address targetVault;
    bytes32 institutionId;
    bool active;
    uint64 registeredAt;
}
```
